intro: Here you can find a (continuously updated) selection of books I have read and would recommend.

books.title: Il genio dei numeri
books.description: The biography of John Nash, mathematician and winner of the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel in 1994.

books.title: Matematica fuori dalle regole
books.description: A short text packed with food for thought on mathematics education: suitable for parents, teachers, and anyone who is apprehensive about this subject.

books.title: La fisica dei supereroi
books.description: An unusual physics manual, suitable for all the curious and enthusiasts.
